name: bombot-forge
description: BomBot's NetSuite delivery forge — personal Claude Code skills for shipping SuiteScript safely: SDF prod deploy (import-compare-confirm + temp-authid trap + guardrails), live read-only verification via Dev Bridge / dbgQuery (accounts/GL/fields/script-deployment + SuiteQL gotchas), scoped record writes via a browser helper (ns_write: submitFields + load/save, structured args, account guard, dry-run, allow-rule validation; bsk engine for sandbox with dialog guard and unknown-outcome stop, cdp engine anywhere), turning an account-owned bundle into a version-controlled SDF repo (Convert to SDF Project, legacy scriptid Change ID, path-fidelity rules), transcribing video/audio to SRT/TXT/MD via the homelab bombot MCP (Tailscale bridge to a Windows GPU box: scp-to-inbox, size verify, sync transcribe_video, scp-back), browser driving with bsk (BrowserSkill) as the default for read/QA — own session + pinned tab, dialog guard, NetSuite identity gate, bounded observe — and Chrome for Testing + cdp.py (fixed profile on port 9333, coordinator rules, shadow-DOM, safe click-submit login) for writes and dialog-sensitive work, syncing a machine's global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md to a redacted reference snapshot (compare + section-merge, never blind-overwrite), setup + checker for the default local-llm worker (Ollama on the tailnet GPU box via the ollama MCP), a teibto-agent subagent that hands edits to the coding-agent CLI on the company DeepSeek key (the older teibto-worker subagent, /teibto-worker, /teibto-code and setup-teibto-worker are deprecated; the TEIBTO key step, ask_cheap.py helper and price table now live in setup-coding-agent, key per machine, never in the repo), and a setup-coding-agent (Cline/OpenCode as the worker, worktree-isolated run helper, Claude briefs and reviews), an interactive setup-browser (choose bsk or cdp with trade-offs, install, optional Claude in Chrome, Dev Bridge trial, login-click consent), and building verified stakeholder decision briefs.
